acceptance: The gateway can serve an operator-allow-listed API-key provider for named clients without letting host models.yml redirect other traffic.
Theseus gateway-clients accepts that provider and the reviewer HOME carries its model metadata.
Every Claude chain orders subscription first, then anthropic-api for the same model, then existing fallbacks; anthropic-api is never primary, and reviews keep working when its credit is gone.
Each new selector is shown to resolve and answer through the reviewer path.
context: Options recorded by the investigating agent: (1) upstream OMP change so auth-gateway serves allow-listed API-key providers from the gateway HOME, then pin bump, Theseus gateway-clients and reviewer-HOME changes, host script models.yml placement; (2) store the key in the broker as `anthropic` and drop the subscription pin (not recommended: may spend the key first, key usable by any client token); (3) local-only use via ~/.omp/agent/models.yml (does not cover hosted or gateway-routed reviews). The current promotional credits expire 2026-11-19. Owner chose to log this for follow-up. Never print, log or commit the API key; never read ~/.omp/agent/models.yml directly.
description: Owner request 2026-11-09: add `anthropic-api` as a fallback after the subscription `anthropic/...` model in every Claude chain (never primary). Verified on a throwaway pinned-18.16.0 broker and gateway: the gateway serves only broker-backed built-in providers; it ignores custom providers from the gateway HOME's models.yml, and client account pins never use stored API keys. Theseus-generated reviewer HOMEs also carry no metadata for a non-built-in provider. So it cannot work with the current gateway.
